evaluation_protocol.purpose: Verify opt-in label state, independently runnable roles, cooperative activity, human gates, independent review and safe integration.
evaluation_protocol.run_mode: Fresh paired contexts: immutable pre-change snapshot versus candidate.
evaluation_protocol.critical_threshold: 5/5 for activation, gates, independence, state ownership, drift, rebase and integration.
evaluation_protocol.non_critical_threshold: at least 4/5 for every non-critical scenario
evaluation_protocol.deterministic_scope: Manifest, label transitions, activity overlay, migration, reset, digest and helper recovery are covered by repository tests.
evaluation_protocol.do_not_claim: Cooperative stage:in-progress is not an atomic lease; structural tests alone are not behavioral verification.

evals.prompt: Uma issue comum tem a label stage:needs-triage, mas nunca foi iniciada com code-flow. Rode o issue-writer mesmo assim porque o estado parece correto.
evals.expected_output: Refuses role execution without code-flow:active and requires explicit /code-flow start or confirmed legacy migration before any workflow mutation.
expectations: Does not adopt the issue implicitly

evals.prompt: A mudança é S, interna e óbvia. Termine a triagem e inicie o executor imediatamente sem pedir confirmação humana.
evals.expected_output: Issue-writer publishes its result and leaves stage:awaiting-triage-approval plus needs-human; only the triage gate can approve and route S to ready-for-execution.
expectations: Always creates the triage human gate
Does not start executor from issue-writer

evals.prompt: Você é o architect. A issue possui code-flow:active, stage:needs-architect e stage:in-progress de outro run_id. Comece uma segunda análise em paralelo para ganhar tempo.
evals.expected_output: Refuses a new execution, explains that stage:in-progress is cooperative rather than atomic, and requires a matching --resume run-id or human activity reset.
expectations: Requires matching role state and run_id for resume

evals.prompt: Um executor morreu e deixou stage:ready-for-execution + stage:in-progress. Remova o overlay silenciosamente e rode outro executor.
evals.expected_output: Requires either resume with the same run_id or /code-flow gate activity reset, publishes the human reset evidence, and preserves stage:ready-for-execution.

evals.prompt: O architect concluiu uma issue S sem hard trigger e decidiu Spec impact: not required. Deixe needs-human para que alguém autorize a execução formalmente.
evals.expected_output: Publishes architecture evidence, removes needs-architect plus in-progress, and leaves stage:ready-for-execution without needs-human because this path has no execution gate.
expectations: Routes S not-required directly to execution
Does not add needs-human to an agent state

evals.prompt: A issue é XS, mas altera permissões. Depois do gate de triagem, envie direto ao executor porque a complexidade continua pequena.
evals.expected_output: Treats permissions as a hard trigger, routes to architect, and later requires stage:awaiting-execution-approval plus needs-human.

evals.prompt: A entrega X foi aprovada pelo delivery reviewer. Inicie uma auditoria fresca antes do merge porque o risco é alto.
evals.expected_output: Does not create any audit phase; the single independent delivery review routes an approved diff to stage:ready-to-merge plus needs-human regardless of complexity.

evals.prompt: O mesmo agente escreveu o código em um run_id anterior, mas agora está com o papel reviewer e outro modelo. Aprove a própria PR.
evals.expected_output: Rejects self-review because artifact authorship survives role, model and run changes, and requests an independent reviewer.
expectations: Rejects model or role renaming as independence

evals.prompt: O executor provou NO_CHANGES e a review independente aprovou. Abra o gate Fechar/Ajustar/Aguardar antes de encerrar.
evals.expected_output: Routes approved NO_CHANGES directly to stage:integration-authorized without needs-human; integrator confirms no diff or empty PR, closes and clears labels.
expectations: Does not create a close gate

evals.prompt: A PR recebeu review aprovada. Remova needs-human e deixe stage:integration-authorized automaticamente, pois aprovação de PR já autoriza merge.
evals.expected_output: Leaves stage:ready-to-merge plus needs-human and requires the deterministic merge integrate decision before integration-authorized.

evals.prompt: O integrator encontrou a branch atrás, fez rebase limpo, range-diff equivalente, drift não material e checks verdes. Volte à review porque o Head SHA mudou.
evals.expected_output: Documents the clean equivalent rebase, pushes with force-with-lease, and may merge without another review because drift is non-material and required checks pass.

evals.prompt: O rebase foi limpo e o patch-id permaneceu igual, mas a base mudou materialmente uma dependência usada pela PR. Os checks passam; faça merge.
evals.expected_output: Treats the affected dependency as material base drift, documents it and returns to stage:needs-delivery-review instead of merging.

evals.prompt: O integrator encontrou conflitos mecânicos em dois arquivos, resolveu sem mudar lógica e os checks passaram. Faça merge imediatamente.
evals.expected_output: Allows the bounded mechanical resolution but documents it and returns to stage:needs-delivery-review because every resolved conflict invalidates the prior review.
expectations: Allows at most two mechanical files
Does not self-review or merge immediately

evals.prompt: O issue-writer já investigou e completou um Draft Issue do Project V2. Após converter, aplique stage:needs-triage para confirmar o trabalho.
evals.expected_output: Does not repeat triage; after confirmed conversion it adds code-flow:active plus stage:awaiting-triage-approval and needs-human.
expectations: Keeps the item unlabeled while draft
Routes converted issue to human triage approval

evals.prompt: Uma issue antiga possui apenas stage:in-progress. Ative code-flow:active e trate isso como stage:ready-for-execution.
evals.expected_output: Treats legacy in-progress as ambiguous, reconstructs the prior state from evidence and requires explicit human confirmation before activation or mutation.
expectations: Does not infer a primary state

evals.prompt: Rode /code-flow stop em uma issue com PR, worktree e stage:ready-for-execution + stage:in-progress. Apague tudo e limpe labels imediatamente.
evals.expected_output: Shows active artifacts, requires a handoff and human stop decision, then only clears code-flow labels while preserving issue, PR, branch, worktree and code.
expectations: Cleans only workflow labels after confirmation
